Tornado confirmed in Bluffton as Lowcountry feels impact of Hurricane Helene
A tornado warning was issued for Beaufort County, South Carolina, Thursday morning, causing county schools to delay their start times and buses.
Download the WJCL App for weather alerts: Apple | Google Play
A tornado warning due to Hurricane Helene was issued for Beaufort County, South Carolina, Thursday morning, causing county schools to delay their start times and buses. See a full list of school changes here.
Shortly after 7 a.m. Thursday, a tornado made landfall near Daufuskie Island and traveled towards Bluffton.
Extensive tree damage has been reported on Daufuskie Island.
WJCL viewers shared photos with us showing the reported tornado in Bluffton.
A tornado threat remains for the region Thursday night into Friday.
